# UKDesk (ukvisainfo.co.uk)

> Free UK calculators, visa routes and plain-English explainers, checked against official sources (GOV.UK, HMRC, ONS). No sign-up, no paywall. All figures are estimates, not financial, legal or tax advice.

## Tools
- [Tool index](https://ukvisainfo.co.uk/tools): All live calculators and checkers
- [Take-home pay calculator](https://ukvisainfo.co.uk/take-home-pay): Net pay after Income Tax, NI, pension and student loan
- [Mortgage calculator](https://ukvisainfo.co.uk/mortgage-calculator): Repayments, interest and overpayments
- [Mortgage affordability](https://ukvisainfo.co.uk/mortgage-affordability): How much you can borrow
- [Stamp duty (SDLT) calculator](https://ukvisainfo.co.uk/stamp-duty-calculator): England & NI, inc. surcharges
- [Council tax band](https://ukvisainfo.co.uk/council-tax-band): Band lookup by postcode
- [VAT calculator](https://ukvisainfo.co.uk/vat-calculator): Add or remove 20% VAT
- [IHS calculator](https://ukvisainfo.co.uk/ihs-calculator): Immigration Health Surcharge cost
- [Skilled Worker points check](https://ukvisainfo.co.uk/skilled-worker-points-check): 70-point eligibility

## Guides
- [Guides & analysis](https://ukvisainfo.co.uk/blog): Plain-English UK visa, money and property guides
- [UK visa routes](https://ukvisainfo.co.uk/visa-types): Skilled Worker, family, study and more
- [Settlement & ILR](https://ukvisainfo.co.uk/settlement): Indefinite leave to remain
